asr.text: The state of AI in 2027. Here is the outlook.
Agents could turn more requests into completed work with tools and review.
Text, voice and vision could become one continuous interaction.
World models could let us test agents in simulated environments.
But greater capability will demand stronger control.

limitations: Sampled-frame visual review rather than manual frame-by-frame review.
The supplied 556x242 JPEG logo is enlarged without redrawing; inherent compression and subtle background variation remain.
Forecast content is explicitly an outlook.
